title: When the Ledger Burns Anew
author: Emrys Eastwick
blurb: Rafael Sterling, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
